settings.heading: Care that feels considered.
settings.body: Maison Calla began as Dr. Elena Voss's answer to rushed med-spa visits. The house is small on purpose: a medical director on site, a short roster of specialists, and enough time in the room to do the work properly. Every guest is invited to request the same practitioner again.

settings.heading: A few rules for a quieter kind of spa.

settings.title: Clinical rigor
settings.text: Every injectable visit is physician-led or supervised, with a clear plan before anything is placed.

settings.title: Considered luxury
settings.text: Quiet rooms, unhurried appointments, and no hard sell — the room is set up for the work, not a retail script.

settings.title: Continuity of care
settings.text: Guests can request the same practitioner each visit, so results and relationships compound over time.

settings.heading: A small roster, known by name.
settings.helper_text: Select a practitioner to read their bio, certifications, treatments, and next openings.

settings.name: Dr. Elena Voss
settings.bio: Elena founded Maison Calla so clinical injectables and facial care could live under one unhurried roof. Guests can request her or the practitioner who last saw them.
